questions.question: How does populism typically frame politics?
options: As a struggle between "the people" and "the elite"
As a debate among scientific experts
questions.explanation: Populism frames politics as a struggle between a virtuous "people" and a corrupt "elite".

questions.question: What is the key difference between disinformation and misinformation?
options: Disinformation is spread deliberately to deceive; misinformation is not
questions.explanation: Disinformation is false information spread deliberately to deceive; misinformation is false information spread without intent to deceive.

questions.question: According to Freedom House, what has happened to global freedom over recent years?
options: It has declined for more than 15 consecutive years
questions.explanation: Freedom House reports that global freedom has declined for more than 15 consecutive years.

questions.question: What is an "echo chamber" in the context of social media?
options: An environment where users mainly see views that reinforce their own
A place where all viewpoints are equally shown
questions.explanation: Echo chambers and filter bubbles show users content aligned with their existing views, reducing exposure to diverse perspectives.

questions.question: Why is political polarisation a threat to democracy?
options: It makes compromise harder and erodes mutual trust
questions.explanation: Growing polarisation makes compromise difficult and erodes the mutual trust that democracy depends on.
